function.name: ryn_shell_execute
function.description: Execute PowerShell/CMD (Windows) or sh (POSIX) on this consumer computer. cwd must be inside workspace. function.name: ryn_file_read
function.description: Read a UTF-8 local workspace file (up to 1 MiB): a page of up to 12000 characters ending on a line boundary, with start_line, end_line, total_lines and the whole-file SHA256. Address by line with start_line (and optional max_lines, up to 400), e.g. the line numbers returned by ryn_file_search; or continue with next_start_line / next_offset. Read what you need once; do not re-read pages you already have. Binary files require command-line tools.

function.name: ryn_file_search
function.description: Search literal text across local workspace files. Bounded recursive search with line numbers, offset pagination and explicit incomplete coverage. Searches shallow directories first and skips binary files, VCS/dependency/cache directories and plain directory names from the workspace root .gitignore (wildcards, nested ignore files and negations are not interpreted); skipped directories are listed in pruned_directories. To search inside one, pass it as path. Narrow path to a source folder for speed.

function.name: ryn_request_input
function.description: Structured input for essential work facts only; casual clarification uses chat. Generated files use the supplied workspace, no directory question. Input answers never authorize writes or external directories. Credentials: kind=credential_ref, only credential_ref fields; never ask keys in chat. Other facts: information/choice with text/choice fields.

function.name: ryn_read_result
function.description: Read a bounded page of this task's encrypted large tool result. Old resource-scope epochs cannot be read into the model.

function.name: ryn_discover_tools
function.description: Load exact business-tool schemas by name; load replaces exposed tools and [] clears them. Available names appear in load.items.enum when they fit. Optional cursor browses bounded brief descriptions; next_cursor continues. Full descriptions/parameters are returned as loaded schemas. Cached schemas may be released for space; reload absent tools. Loading never grants permission.
